args.value: 1 A low-dropout 3.3 V LDO, 2-5.5 V in, 455 mV dropout @ 1 A, SOT-223 (TI TLV1117LV)

args.text:
D42/D43 diode-OR: battery (+5V) or USB VBUS feeds the 3.3 V LDO (U4); neither can back-feed the other.
USB alone runs only the 3.3 V side (MCU, SD, IMU, baro, LEDs). Firmware: detect it from the rail monitors
(PC2 VIN, PB2 5V) and skip ADC / CAN / sensor-supply init. Enable the USB D+ pull-up only while PA9 sees VBUS.
LDO headroom ~4.6 V in vs AMS1117 dropout ~1.1 V: OK, tight at low VBUS - a low-dropout 3.3 V LDO would add margin.

D42/D43 diode-OR: battery (+5V) or USB VBUS feeds the 3.3 V LDO (U4); neither can back-feed the other.
USB alone runs only the 3.3 V side (MCU, SD, IMU, baro, LEDs). Firmware: detect it from the rail monitors
(PC2 VIN, PB2 5V) and skip ADC / CAN / sensor-supply init. Enable the USB D+ pull-up only while PA9 sees VBUS.
U4 = TLV1117LV33 (dropout ~90 mV @ 200 mA): ~1 V margin from ~4.4-4.6 V in. VIN max 5.5 V - feed only from +5V / VBUS.
